newsitem.title: USA: Mercer to buy C$4.5 mln conv Concert debt.
newsitem.headline: Mercer to buy C$4.5 mln conv Concert debt.

text.p: Mercer International Inc said Monday that it has agreed to buy C$4.5 million of a senior secured convertible debenture of Concert Industries Ltd.
The company said the debt is due July 15, 2000 and convertible into common shares of Concert at C$2.30 per share, increasing by C$0.10 per year.

Mercer also said that upon a 30-day review and the approval of Concert shareholders, it may acquire Concert Industries through a private placement of 3.3 million units from Concert's treasury at $C2.15 per unit, with each unit consisting of one common share and one non-transferrable common share warrant to acquire additional shares at $C2.15 until August 14, 1998. The share price will increase by C$0.10 per year until a maximum price of $C2.35 has been reached.
Mercer is a European pulp and paper manufacturing company. Concert Industries makes air-laid, non-woven paper products.
